we have proposed a performability evaluation framework to evaluate the performance of resource scheduling algorithms, which is based on the stochastic reward nets (SNR) and the hierarchical resource scheduling architecture.

we proposed a stochastic reward nets based performability evaluation model for evaluating the performable of resource scheduling algorithms in computational grids with resource unavailability, and the proposed evaluation model is applied to evaluate the performability of 36 combinations of global and local resource scheduling algorithms in a hierarchical resource scheduling architecture.
